def is_equal_to_sum_even(n):
    """Evaluate whether the given number n can be written as the sum of exactly 4 positive even numbers"""
    
    if n <= 8:
        return False
    
    # The smallest sum of four positive even numbers is 2+2+2+2 = 8.
    # Any integer >= 8 that has the same parity as 8 (i.e., even) can be represented 
    # because we can increase one of the terms by 2 repeatedly to reach any larger even number.
    
    return n % 2 == 0

def is_equal_to_sum_even(n):
    """Evaluate whether the given number n can be written as the sum of exactly 4 positive even numbers"""
    
    if n <= 8:
        return False
    
    # The smallest sum of four positive even numbers is 2+2+2+2 = 8.
    # Any integer >= 8 that has the same parity as 8 (i.e., even) can be represented 
    # because we can increase one of the terms by 2 repeatedly to reach any larger even number.
    
    return n % 2 == 0
